clues.text: When the LORD destroyed Sodom, Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of this.
In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus told His listeners that they were this of the earth.
At Jericho, Elisha threw this into the bad spring, and the LORD said He had healed the water.
The LORD told Moses that every grain offering must be seasoned with this, a sign of His covenant.
After capturing Shechem and killing its people, Abimelech tore the city down and sowed it with this.
In his suffering, Job asked whether tasteless food could be eaten without this.
Paul told the Colossians to let their speech always be gracious and seasoned with this.
